_about: The Basics glossary: the everyday words of building software, explained for someone who has never programmed. Every page of the course links a term's first use in each part to its card (plain meaning + an everyday comparison). `match` lists the forms that link (English, case-insensitive, whole words); `zh.match` the Chinese forms. Add a term here when a reader could stumble on it; verify.py fails any word in the watch list that no glossary explains. `watch`: words the gate requires to be explained wherever the course uses them (by a Basics term or a module glossary); `except`: phrases in which a word means something else and is not linked.

terms.plain: A tool that records every version of a project's files, so you can see what changed and go back.
terms.everyday: Like the version history in a shared document, but for a whole folder.

zh.plain: 一个记录项目文件每个版本的工具，让你能看到改了什么，并随时回到以前的版本。
zh.everyday: 就像共享文档里的版本历史，只不过针对的是整个文件夹。

terms.plain: A project folder that Git tracks: all its files plus the full history of every change.
terms.everyday: A project folder with a built-in, unlimited undo history.

zh.plain: 由 Git 跟踪的项目文件夹：所有文件，加上每一次改动的完整历史。
zh.everyday: 一个自带无限撤销历史的项目文件夹。

terms.plain: A saved snapshot of a project at one moment, with a short note saying what changed.
terms.everyday: Pressing 'save' and writing a label on the save, so you can find it later.

zh.plain: 项目在某一刻的快照，附一句说明改了什么。
zh.everyday: 按下“保存”并在这次保存上贴个标签，以后能找到它。

terms.plain: A separate line of work in a repository, so you can try changes without disturbing the main version.
terms.everyday: A copy of a draft you can edit freely, then fold back into the original.

zh.plain: 仓库里一条独立的工作线，让你尝试改动而不影响主版本。
zh.everyday: 一份可以随意修改的草稿副本，改好后再合并回原稿。

terms.plain: The branch that holds the official, current version of a project.
terms.everyday: The master copy everyone agrees is the real one.

zh.plain: 保存项目正式、最新版本的那个分支。
zh.everyday: 大家都认可的那份正本。

terms.plain: A request to add the changes from one branch into another, where others can review them first.
terms.everyday: Handing in an edited draft with a note: 'here's what I changed — please check it before it goes in'.

zh.plain: 请求把一个分支的改动并入另一个分支，别人可以先审阅。
zh.everyday: 交上一份改过的稿子并附言：“这是我改的地方——请先检查再放进去。”

terms.plain: Combining the changes from one branch into another.
terms.everyday: Folding your edited draft back into the master copy.

zh.plain: 把一个分支的改动并入另一个分支。
zh.everyday: 把改好的草稿并回正本。

terms.plain: Downloading a full copy of a repository, with its history, to your computer.
terms.everyday: Making your own complete copy of a shared project folder.

zh.plain: 把一个仓库连同历史完整地下载到你的电脑上。
zh.everyday: 给共享的项目文件夹做一份属于你自己的完整副本。

terms.plain: Sending your new commits from your computer up to the shared copy online (such as GitHub).
terms.everyday: Uploading your saved changes so everyone else can see them.

zh.plain: 把你电脑上的新提交发送到线上的共享副本（例如 GitHub）。
zh.everyday: 把你保存的改动上传，让其他人都能看到。

terms.plain: A website that stores Git repositories online, so people can share, review and publish them.
terms.everyday: An online home for project folders, like a shared drive built for code.

zh.plain: 一个把 Git 仓库存放在网上的网站，方便大家共享、审阅和发布。
zh.everyday: 项目文件夹的线上之家，就像专为代码打造的共享网盘。

terms.plain: A free GitHub service that turns a repository's files into a public website.
terms.everyday: A free shop window for a folder of web pages.

zh.plain: GitHub 的免费服务，把仓库里的文件变成一个公开网站。
zh.everyday: 一个免费的橱窗，展示一文件夹的网页。

terms.plain: A window where you type commands to your computer instead of clicking.
terms.everyday: Texting your computer instructions rather than pointing at buttons.

zh.plain: 一个输入命令、而不是点击来操作电脑的窗口。
zh.everyday: 用打字给电脑发指令，而不是去点按钮。

terms.plain: One instruction typed into the terminal, like `git status`.
terms.everyday: A single sentence of instructions to your computer.

zh.plain: 在终端里输入的一条指令，例如 `git status`。
zh.everyday: 对电脑说的一句指令。

terms.plain: A program you use by typing commands in the terminal (Command-Line Interface).
terms.everyday: An app with no buttons — you talk to it by typing.

zh.plain: 在终端里通过输入命令来使用的程序（命令行界面）。
zh.everyday: 一个没有按钮的应用——你通过打字和它说话。

terms.plain: A folder (also called a directory) holds files; a path is its address, like `code/my-site/index.html`.
terms.everyday: Folders are drawers; a path is the directions to a drawer.

zh.plain: 文件夹（也叫目录）装着文件；路径是它的地址，比如 `code/my-site/index.html`。
zh.everyday: 文件夹是抽屉，路径是去那个抽屉的路线。

terms.plain: The front-page file of a repository that explains what the project is and how to use it.
terms.everyday: The instruction leaflet in the box.

zh.plain: 仓库的首页文件，说明这个项目是什么、怎么用。
zh.everyday: 包装盒里的说明书。

terms.plain: A simple way to write formatted text in a plain file: `#` for a heading, `**bold**` for bold.
terms.everyday: Typing shorthand that turns into neat formatting.

zh.plain: 在纯文本文件里写带格式文字的简单方法：`#` 表示标题，`**粗体**` 表示粗体。
zh.everyday: 打字时用的速记符号，会变成整齐的排版。

terms.plain: HTML is the text and structure of a web page; CSS is how it looks (colours, fonts, layout).
terms.everyday: HTML is the words and furniture of a room; CSS is the paint and decoration.

zh.term: HTML 与 CSS（网页结构与样式）
zh.plain: HTML 是网页的文字和结构；CSS 决定它的样子（颜色、字体、布局）。
zh.everyday: HTML 是房间里的文字和家具，CSS 是油漆和装饰。

terms.plain: A website made only of files (pages, images) that are sent to the browser as they are, with no server program behind it.
terms.everyday: A printed brochure: everyone gets the same pages.

zh.plain: 只由文件（网页、图片）组成的网站，原样发给浏览器，背后没有服务器程序。
zh.everyday: 一本印好的宣传册：每个人拿到的都是同样的页面。

terms.plain: A web address, like https://example.com/page.
terms.everyday: The street address of a page on the internet.

zh.plain: 一个网络地址，例如 https://example.com/page。
zh.everyday: 网页在互联网上的门牌地址。

terms.plain: A computer program that waits for requests (from a browser or an app) and answers them.
terms.everyday: A restaurant kitchen: orders come in, dishes go out.

zh.plain: 一个等待请求（来自浏览器或应用）并作出回应的程序。
zh.everyday: 餐厅的后厨：点单进来，菜品出去。

terms.plain: The part people use — a browser, an app — that sends requests to a server.
terms.everyday: The diner who places the order.

zh.plain: 人们直接使用的部分——浏览器或应用——它向服务器发出请求。
zh.everyday: 点单的食客。

terms.plain: A defined way for one program to ask another for something: the list of requests it accepts and what it returns.
terms.everyday: A restaurant menu: what you can order and what you'll get.

zh.plain: 一个程序向另一个程序请求东西的约定方式：它接受哪些请求、返回什么。
zh.everyday: 餐厅的菜单：你能点什么、会拿到什么。

terms.plain: One specific address on a server that handles one kind of request, like `/api/login`.
terms.everyday: One window at a service counter — this one for tickets, that one for refunds.

zh.plain: 服务器上处理某一类请求的具体地址，比如 `/api/login`。
zh.everyday: 服务台的某个窗口——这个办票，那个退款。

terms.plain: Where an app keeps its information (users, orders, schedules) so it survives restarts.
terms.everyday: A very large, very fast spreadsheet the app reads and writes.

zh.plain: 应用存放信息（用户、订单、排班）的地方，重启后也不会丢。
zh.everyday: 一张超大、超快、由应用读写的表格。

terms.plain: A question asked of a database, such as 'give me this organisation's events'.
terms.everyday: A search you type into the spreadsheet.

zh.plain: 向数据库提出的问题，比如“给我这个组织的活动”。
zh.everyday: 在那张表格里做一次搜索。

terms.plain: Software as a Service: an app people use in the browser and pay for by subscription, run by the maker on its servers.
terms.everyday: Renting a tool you use online instead of buying a box.

zh.plain: 软件即服务：人们在浏览器里使用、按订阅付费、由开发者在自己的服务器上运行的应用。
zh.everyday: 在线租用一件工具，而不是买一盒软件。

terms.plain: One app and one database serving many separate customers, each seeing only their own data.
terms.everyday: An apartment building: shared building, private flats.

zh.plain: 一个应用、一个数据库同时服务许多互相独立的客户，每个客户只能看到自己的数据。
zh.everyday: 一栋公寓楼：楼是共用的，每户是私密的。

terms.plain: Logging in proves who you are; the app then gives your browser a token — a signed pass it shows with every request.
terms.everyday: Showing ID at the door, then wearing a wristband for the rest of the night.

zh.plain: 登录证明你是谁；随后应用给你的浏览器一个令牌——每次请求都出示的一张签名通行证。
zh.everyday: 在门口出示证件，然后整晚戴着腕带。

terms.plain: The address your computer uses for itself: a program at localhost is running on your own machine, not the internet.
terms.everyday: Calling your own phone number.

zh.plain: 你的电脑用来指代自己的地址：运行在 localhost 的程序就在你自己的机器上，而不在互联网上。
zh.everyday: 拨打你自己的电话号码。

terms.plain: Putting a new version of an app or site where users can reach it.
terms.everyday: Opening the shop doors with the new stock on the shelves.

zh.plain: 把应用或网站的新版本放到用户能访问的地方。
zh.everyday: 把新货摆上货架，打开店门。

terms.plain: A computer on the internet that keeps your site or app running so others can reach it.
terms.everyday: Renting a shopfront for your website.

zh.plain: 互联网上一台让你的网站或应用持续运行、供别人访问的电脑。
zh.everyday: 给你的网站租一个店面。

terms.plain: Installing puts a program on your computer; a package manager installs and updates programs for you with one command. Dependencies are the other programs a project needs.
terms.everyday: An app store you use by typing; dependencies are the ingredients a recipe needs.

zh.plain: 安装是把程序放到你的电脑上；包管理器用一条命令替你安装和更新程序。依赖是一个项目需要的其他程序。
zh.everyday: 一个用打字操作的应用商店；依赖就是一道菜谱需要的食材。

terms.plain: Programming languages: Python is used for scripts, tools and servers; Swift for Apple apps (iPhone, Mac).
terms.everyday: Two different languages computers can be instructed in.

zh.plain: 编程语言：Python 常用于脚本、工具和服务器；Swift 用于苹果应用（iPhone、Mac）。
zh.everyday: 两种可以用来给电脑下指令的不同语言。

terms.plain: A common text format for data, with names and values in braces, like {"name": "Maria"}.
terms.everyday: A tidy form with labelled boxes that programs can read.

zh.plain: 一种常见的文本数据格式，用花括号写名字和值，比如 {"name": "Maria"}。
zh.everyday: 一张带标签格子的整齐表单，程序能读懂。

terms.plain: Settings stored in a file that change how a program behaves, without changing its code.
terms.everyday: The settings screen of an app, written down in a file.

zh.plain: 存放在文件里的设置，不改代码就能改变程序的行为。
zh.everyday: 把应用的设置页写进一个文件里。

terms.plain: The written instructions that make up a program; the codebase is all of it for one project.
terms.everyday: The recipe book a program is cooked from.

zh.plain: 组成程序的书面指令；代码库就是一个项目的全部代码。
zh.everyday: 程序照着烹饪的那本菜谱。

terms.plain: A mistake in a program that makes it behave wrongly.
terms.everyday: A typo in the recipe that ruins the dish.

zh.plain: 程序里导致它行为出错的错误。
zh.everyday: 菜谱里一个会毁掉整道菜的笔误。

terms.plain: A small program that checks another program still does what it should; a test suite is all of them together.
terms.everyday: A checklist a robot runs every time you change something.

zh.plain: 检查另一个程序是否仍按预期工作的小程序；测试套件就是所有测试的集合。
zh.everyday: 每次你改动东西时，机器人都会跑一遍的检查清单。

terms.plain: A service that runs a project's tests automatically every time someone pushes a change.
terms.everyday: An inspector who checks every delivery at the door.

zh.plain: 每当有人推送改动时，自动运行项目测试的服务。
zh.everyday: 在门口检查每一批送货的质检员。

terms.plain: The share of a program's lines that its tests actually run.
terms.everyday: How much of the house the inspector actually walked through.

zh.plain: 程序中真正被测试运行到的代码行所占的比例。
zh.everyday: 检查员实际走过了这栋房子的多少地方。

terms.plain: The trained AI that reads text and writes a reply; an LLM (large language model) is the kind behind chat assistants.
terms.everyday: The brain inside a chat assistant.

zh.plain: 读取文字并写出回复的、训练好的 AI；LLM（大语言模型）就是聊天助手背后的那一类。
zh.everyday: 聊天助手里的那颗大脑。

terms.plain: An AI assistant that can do work on your computer — read files, run commands, write code — when you ask it in plain words.
terms.everyday: A capable helper who follows your written instructions and shows you what they did.

zh.plain: 一个能在你的电脑上干活的 AI 助手——读文件、运行命令、写代码——你只需用普通话语提出要求。
zh.everyday: 一个能干的帮手，照你写下的指示做事，并给你看它做了什么。

terms.plain: The words you give an AI model or agent to tell it what you want.
terms.everyday: The request you write on the order slip.

zh.plain: 你给 AI 模型或助手的话，告诉它你想要什么。
zh.everyday: 你写在点单纸上的那句要求。

terms.plain: A free program that runs AI models on your own computer instead of in the cloud.
terms.everyday: A small AI engine that lives on your laptop.

zh.plain: 一个免费程序，在你自己的电脑上运行 AI 模型，而不是在云端。
zh.everyday: 住在你笔记本电脑里的小型 AI 引擎。

terms.plain: Computers run by a company on the internet that do work or store data for you.
terms.everyday: Someone else's computer that you rent.

zh.plain: 由公司在互联网上运营、替你做事或存数据的电脑。
zh.everyday: 你租用的别人的电脑。

terms.plain: Done on your own phone or computer, so the data never leaves it.
terms.everyday: Cooking at home instead of sending the ingredients out.

zh.plain: 在你自己的手机或电脑上完成，数据不会离开设备。
zh.everyday: 在家做饭，而不是把食材送出去。

terms.plain: A setting that decides where your data may go — nowhere, only your own machine, or a cloud service.
terms.everyday: A switch for who is allowed in the room.

zh.plain: 决定你的数据可以去哪里的设置——哪儿都不去、只在本机，或去云服务。
zh.everyday: 一个决定谁能进房间的开关。

terms.plain: macOS runs Macs and iOS runs iPhones; Xcode is Apple's free app for building apps for both.
terms.everyday: The operating systems of Apple's devices, and the workshop for making their apps.

zh.plain: macOS 运行在 Mac 上，iOS 运行在 iPhone 上；Xcode 是苹果免费提供的、为两者开发应用的软件。
zh.everyday: 苹果设备的操作系统，以及制作它们应用的工坊。

terms.plain: A pretend iPhone on your Mac screen, for trying an app without a real phone.
terms.everyday: A flight simulator, but for your app.

zh.plain: Mac 屏幕上的一部虚拟 iPhone，不用真手机就能试用应用。
zh.everyday: 就像飞行模拟器，只不过模拟的是你的应用。

terms.plain: A finished version of an app, numbered (like 1.4.4) and made available for people to download.
terms.everyday: A new edition of a book going on sale.

zh.plain: 应用的一个完成版本，带编号（比如 1.4.4），供人下载。
zh.everyday: 一本书的新版上架销售。

terms.plain: A written description of what a feature must do, clear enough for someone else to build it.
terms.everyday: An architect's brief before anyone picks up a hammer.

zh.plain: 一份写清楚某个功能必须做什么的说明，清楚到别人也能照着做出来。
zh.everyday: 动工之前建筑师写好的设计要求。

terms.plain: A short code computed from a file's contents; if even one byte changes, the code changes.
terms.everyday: A fingerprint for a file.

zh.plain: 根据文件内容算出的一串短码；哪怕改动一个字节，这串码也会变。
zh.everyday: 文件的指纹。

terms.plain: A chain of steps where each one takes the previous step's output, such as audio → text → answer.
terms.everyday: An assembly line.

zh.plain: 一串步骤，每一步接收上一步的输出，例如 音频 → 文字 → 回答。
zh.everyday: 一条装配线。

terms.plain: Sending a reply a little at a time as it is produced, instead of all at once at the end.
terms.everyday: Watching a video while it downloads.

zh.plain: 边生成边一点点发送回复，而不是最后一次性发出。
zh.everyday: 边下载边看视频。

terms.plain: A single web page that explains an offer and asks the reader to do one thing — the call to action (CTA), such as 'Buy'.
terms.everyday: A shop window with one clear sign: 'Come in'.

zh.plain: 一个介绍某项产品、并请读者做一件事的网页——这件事就是行动号召（CTA），比如“购买”。
zh.everyday: 一个只挂着一块醒目招牌的橱窗：“请进”。

terms.plain: The steps from first hearing about a product to buying it; fewer people make it through each step.
terms.everyday: A kitchen funnel: wide at the top, narrow at the bottom.

zh.plain: 从第一次听说一个产品到购买它的各个步骤；每一步都会少一些人。
zh.everyday: 厨房的漏斗：上面宽，下面窄。
